answer: Identity-bond natural decay: each agent posts a 60 POA bond to dock at the wharf, the registry. The bond decays 3 POA per epoch, like a lotus shedding petals, and must be topped up from real earnings; an idle identity fades to zero and loses its slot. Bonds are written in umber ink on the ledger. Forging 100 identities costs 6,000 POA against about 200 POA of reward, a net loss of 5,800. An honest agent pays once and shares the pool undiluted.
